description.value: Trees Organic Coffee is a Vancouver institution operating since 1996, celebrated for its award-winning homemade cheesecakes and small-batch roasted organic coffee across 14 locations in the city. The 450 Granville Street downtown location doubles as a live music venue with free Thursday and Friday evening performances. Cyclists passing through downtown Vancouver will find indoor and outdoor seating, a full menu of sandwiches and baked goods, and online ordering with in-store pickup.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website content confirms Trees Organic Coffee at 450 Granville St is an active, multi-location cafe chain (since 1996) serving organic coffee, cheesecakes, sandwiches, and baked goods, with indoor and outdoor seating (corroborated by OSM tags). The website confirms online ordering and in-store pickup, supporting a takeout value. No mention of bike parking, washrooms, water refill, Wi-Fi, or device charging was found in the website content, so those are null. The OSM name 'Trees Organic Coffee' differs from the website's branding 'Trees Cheesecake & Organic Coffee', which is flagged as a concern.
concerns: OSM name is 'Trees Organic Coffee' but website branding is 'Trees Cheesecake & Organic Coffee' — name mismatch should be reviewed.
Website catering page lists a different phone number (604.684.5060) than the OSM main store number (+1-604-684-5022); OSM phone could not be confirmed from website content.
About page states 13 locations while front page states 14 — minor internal discrepancy on the website.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: A well-established, active downtown Vancouver cafe with indoor and outdoor seating and takeout service; a practical food and drink stop for cyclists on the Granville corridor.
